external_references.description: B. Toulas. (2022, March 12). Android malware Escobar steals your Google Authenticator MFA codes. Retrieved September 28, 2023.

objects.description: [Escobar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1092) can collect sensitive information, such as Google Authenticator codes.(Citation: Bleeipng Computer Escobar)
